compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns IN (VIN) whereas AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns ADJ/GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns GND (GND) whereas AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns OUTPUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns INPUT (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 onto a AP7361C-33E-13 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (GND vs VOUT) — direct swap will short power rails.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs significantly (AP7361C-33E-13: 2.2 µF p.1 vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 10 µF p.3); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7361C-33E-13 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 at 15 V rec. (18 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs by 860 mV (AP7361C-33E-13: 340 mV p.5 vs AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 1200 mV p.7); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo at cold/hot corners.
engineering_verdict: AP7361C-33E-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 60 µA (p.5) vs 4000 µA (p.7), max output current is 1000 mA (p.4) vs 800 mA (p.7), recommended Vin,max is 6 V (p.4) vs 15 V (p.4), typical dropout is 340 mV (p.5) vs 1200 mV (p.7), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.2), thermal margin (θJA 110 vs 125 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
